text: In 2021 the Supreme Court shut a door police had been walking through. It did not shut the one you might need.
provenance: The Court did not say the police can never enter your home without a warrant.

text: The Chief Justice, joined by Justice Breyer, stressed that no warrant is needed to help a person who is seriously injured or threatened with injury.
